{"acceptance_criteria":"Run independent wire/calendar/queue/ledger cases through production Stack/RPL execution and observe actual HAL calls. Cover forwarding, control/SOS attempts during RX, lost sync during await, complete-fragment charges, queue expiry and budget denial. Assert no bypass between send variants and preserve upstream addresses and radio-owned identity. Run relevant rust/lichen-node/tests and RPL integration tests with std and root-sig where applicable, relevant no-default-feature checks, fmt and clippy. Do not bypass an existing control-frame size failure to claim integration.

Additional required acceptance: Production coalescing positive cases in vectors.08 and ci.09 map to a named implemented/reused path. Negative tests preserve nonreplaceable records and distinct recipient/security contexts; no new congestion controller or audited OSCORE changes.","description":"Integrate rust.03-.12 through rust/lichen-node/src/stack.rs, rust/lichen-node/src/runtime.rs and rust/lichen-node/src/rpl_stack/runtime.rs. Cover every send variant and receive/forwarding owner, including control, retries and baseline SCHC fragmentation. All paths must honor receiver commitments, complete-operation fit, synchronization and legal/adaptive accounting while preserving existing queues, deadlines, priorities and back-pressure.

HPC8 execution policy: Code, test, or schema changes require three independent correctness, security, and robustness reviews; file and fix all findings and re-review. Use independent oracles, never weakened legacy tests or self-generated expected results. Preserve upstream Yggdrasil addressing, radio-owned identity, best-effort custody, baseline SCHC, and the human-only OSCORE/EDHOC security edit bar. External actions, hardware/RF operations, and port access require scoped explicit permission and applicable bench safety checks. Research may conclude no-go; an authorization gate requires affirmative, recorded approval for its actual scope. Dependency closure and decomposition are not permission. No speculative activation, including deferred portability or experimental modes.

Decomposition review scope: Explicitly own or verify and reuse bounded coalescing of pending, explicitly replaceable position/status updates at the Rust node/application enqueue boundary. Retain only the latest value for the same resource/recipient/context; preserve distinct messages, commands, receipts, historical samples and custody records. Prefer coalescing before protection and sequence allocation; use existing OSCORE interfaces without nonce reuse or ciphertext reinterpretation.","metadata":{"decomposition":"hpc8-deep","decomposition_review":"scope-handoff-correction","initial_scope_sha256":"3a7ab0af14e608ee0bb51f5c9804cb85badeb96f5c71df03ff42acb1316f9e7b","leaf_key":"rust.13","permission":"none","plan_sha256":"c05b27e14b7037764034ab07df51bb7db783fe4079d5d855e54ea0191ed2f7d1"},"notes":"Task-definition amendment after independent decomposition review. This commissions future work only; nothing was implemented or tested. The initial CLI-input fingerprint is retained as initial_scope_sha256; current native Beads fields are authoritative. Do not rerun the seed applicator over this reviewed amendment."}
